item.title: Is Mexico still safe? Nervous travelers look for alternate destinations
item.description: After this past weekend's violence in Puerto Vallarta, many travelers are rethinking their vacation plans to Mexico. A Mexican travel specialist tells us about alternatives.

item.title: Phil Collins, Lauryn Hill, INXS, Iron Maiden, Luther Vandross and Shakira get Rock Hall nominations
item.description: Phil Collins, Mariah Carey, Lauryn Hill, INXS, Iron Maiden, Luther Vandross and Shakira are some the 2026 nominees for induction into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame.

item.title: Movie tickets cost how much? Here's how to stop overpaying
item.description: Movie ticket prices are up 60% since 2016. Here's how to save on tickets and snacks at AMC and Cinemark.

item.title: What the Tooth Fairy left behind could spark your next family debate
item.description: The Tooth Fairy’s average payout is up 17% from last year, and more kids are getting non-cash surprises under their pillows, according to a new survey.

item.title: Walmart cottage cheese recalled in 24 states over pasteurization concerns
item.description: Three types of Walmart's Great Value brand cottage cheese are being recalled in 24 states over concerns the products may not have been properly pasteurized.

item.title: Couple gets married on Lake Erie ice thanks to massive freeze
item.description: The wedding took place about a hundred yards from the dock, and the couple says they were lucky to have enough ice to bring their idea to life.

item.title: US stocks sink as worries about AI, inflation and possible war hit Wall Street
item.description: U.S. stocks are sinking as Wall Street gets back to hunting and punishing companies that could be made losers by the artificial-intelligence revolution.

item.title: Papa John’s to close more than 300 stores, cut corporate workforce
item.description: Papa John’s plans to close more than 300 underperforming restaurants by the end of 2027, including about 200 locations this year.

item.title: Attorney General Pam Bondi says 30 more people who protested at Minnesota church have been charged
item.description: Attorney General Pam Bondi says federal prosecutors have indicted 30 more people tied to a protest at a Minnesota church over an immigration enforcement crackdown.

item.title: The Danny Moses Show: Could there be another Big Short?
item.description: Danny Moses answers questions he gets asked a lot: Is there another Big Short? Are we seeing the same warning signs today? And what really happened behind the scenes during the financial crisis?
